title: Felix and the Well
author: N. M. Hartwell
blurb: Jonah Okonkwo, a hospice nurse who hears the dying count backwards, keeps the lights on and the doors counted. But when every mirror in the house starts reflecting the room one second late, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must get the family out ahead of the count, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
